exposure: Systemic sclerosis (SSc) diagnosis timing (post-SSc, pre-SSc 0-3 years, pre-SSc >3 years)
cohort: Pregnancies with births in women with systemic sclerosis (SSc) and in comparator women from the general population in Sweden between 1998 and 2021.
finding: Women with systemic sclerosis displayed markedly increased risks of several adverse pregnancy outcomes after SSc diagnosis, with risks already increased before diagnosis, particularly within three years, and especially in the first pregnancy.
mod_finding: Risks of cesarean delivery were increased for post-SSc pregnancies (RR 2.5, 95% CI 1.8-3.5).
